title: Retention Revenue Review
company: SaaS Growth Co. • Weekly Boss Case
context: Leadership wants a concise recurring-revenue review. You must protect the analysis from bad cohort logic, aggregate completed billing by region, calculate concentration, select the right visual, and recommend the next diagnostic step.
cleaningPrompt: Which controls are required before building a retention/revenue review? Select all required actions.
cleaningOptions: Confirm one consistent customer identifier before joining billing data.
Validate that cancelled and refunded orders are not counted as completed revenue.
Keep one documented definition for the reporting period and cohort.
Mix new customers into every retention denominator.
Silently recode missing values to the largest observed category.
cleaningExpectedSelections: Confirm one consistent customer identifier before joining billing data.
Validate that cancelled and refunded orders are not counted as completed revenue.
Keep one documented definition for the reporting period and cohort.
sqlPrompt: Using customers and orders, return region and total_revenue for completed orders only. One row per region.
kpiPrompt: North contributes 4300 of 13400 completed revenue. What percentage comes from North? Round to one decimal.
chartPrompt: Which chart best compares completed revenue across regions?
chartOptions: Bar chart with region and completed revenue
Line chart treating region names as time
Scatter plot of customer name versus row number
Gauge chart for every individual order
chartExpected: Bar chart with region and completed revenue
recommendationOptions: Investigate why West and North differ by segment and cohort, while avoiding a causal claim from regional totals alone.
Conclude West geography causes higher revenue.
Count cancelled orders as revenue to stabilize the chart.
recommendationExpected: Investigate why West and North differ by segment and cohort, while avoiding a causal claim from regional totals alone.
